comment: Sketch1 on XY for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-offset-points.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2278): two free points that frame the view's fit at (-40, -30) and (40, 30) (p1, p2); a cubic B-spline arch c3 on the control points p4 (-20, 0), p5 (-20, 10), p6 (20, 10), p7 (20, 0); its derived offset 4 mm outside the arch (to the left of its direction), which starts at (-24, 0) and ends at (24, 0).
